attention_items: ArcPanel 3.0.0 is a major version: it breaks interfaces that scripts and API clients use. v-run-queue-task is removed; use the job commands (v-list-job, v-list-jobs, v-cancel-job, v-retry-job). REST API v2 task ids are now job:ID, and a task of a removed source answers 404 instead of 410. The upgrade turns task records and queue pipes into jobs, which installing an older package cannot undo. REST API v2 stays v2.

A server upgraded from 2.2 moves its firewall from iptables and ipset to nftables. Rules that data/firewall/custom.sh adds with iptables can no longer open ports; move them to data/firewall/custom.nft.
If the new firewall rules cannot be loaded, the server keeps its iptables rules and the upgrade log says so; check Server > Firewall after the update.
Access keys that the upgrade moves to data/access-keys/.quarantine/ no longer work; the upgrade log and a notification name them. Review where they were used and create new keys.

Accounts that already use two-factor authentication have no recovery codes yet; ask their users to create them on the Security tab of their account. The 2FA reset page is gone: turn 2FA off for a user who lost the app.

Backups now run as jobs that send backups to destinations. The upgrade converts the backup hosts and the nightly runs; check Server > Backups, test each destination, and replace scripts or cron lines that called v-backup-users at a time of their own with a job schedule. The old host files are kept as conf/*.migrated.

Alerts start with the upgrade: the server checks disks, inodes, load, memory, services, certificates and port findings and reports failed jobs, backups, certificates and updates on the panel and by mail to the administrator's contact. The backup and update mails now come from these alert rules; BACKUP_REPORT and UPGRADE_SEND_EMAIL still work in 3.0 and go in 3.1. Review the rules and add Telegram, Slack, Discord or Mattermost channels in Server > Alerts.
